subject: Energy
title: Stranded Assets
description: A quick win: understand Stranded Assets.

hook.text: Stranded assets lose value before their expected lifetime—fossil fuel plants closed early by cheaper alternatives.

buildup.text: A coal plant built to run 40 years may become unprofitable in 20—if solar and wind undercut its electricity price.

discovery.text: Carbon Tracker estimates $1 trillion in oil, gas, and coal assets could be stranded if climate targets are met.

twist.text: Banks and investors are withdrawing financing—some refusing to fund new coal projects to avoid future losses.

climax.text: Coal regions face economic devastation as plants close—workers and communities need 'just transition' support.

punchline.text: Build it for 40 years, close it in 20—stranded assets hurt.

quiz.question: What causes fossil fuel assets to become stranded?
options: Cheaper alternatives making them unprofitable early
